dedupe_keys.name: u s chemical safety board recommendations database

description: The CSB recommendations database lists every safety recommendation the U.S. Chemical Safety Board has issued from its investigations of chemical incidents, with the investigation, recipient, report date, incident type and current status. At access it held 1,061 recommendations, 129 open and 932 closed, with status codes such as closed-acceptable action or open-awaiting response. It is maintained by the U.S. Chemical Safety and Hazard Investigation Board. Coverage is national, spanning more than 100 investigations of chemical manufacturing, refining, combustible dust, toxic gas releases and other incident types. The database is searched free on the web by investigation, recipient, status, report date range, incident type and keyword, with linked PDF summaries of status changes and links to the full investigation reports; there is no bulk download on the page read. Caveats: it records recommendations and their follow-up, not incident data, and statuses reflect the CSB's judgement of the recipients' responses. For simulation it helps identify which process safety and emergency response failures recur across incidents, informing scenario selection for resilience and emergency response studies of chemical and energy facilities. It is related to the CSB West Fertilizer and Philadelphia Energy Solutions case study records in this catalogue, two of the investigations it indexes.
